facts.text: Jolene mentioned that she has been using a bullet journal to manage her tasks and stay organized.

evidence.quote: I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.
It's great to hear that it's been helping you out!

facts.text: Jolene expressed that crossing tasks off her list is satisfying.

evidence.quote: Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list.

facts.text: Jolene shared a photo of her newest bullet journal spread with a favorite quote.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes.
